convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA, iStochastic). Simple entry/exit rules with fixed SL/TP. Position sizing is deposit-fraction based but straightforward. Single include (Trade.mqh) is standard MQL5 trade class, not custom logic.

derived_values.name: Dynamic lot size from free margin

other_exits: SL/TP set at order open time only, no dynamic exit logic

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lots = FreeMargin / 100000 * 50, clamped to [0.1, 15]. Normalization: <0.1→2 decimals, <1→1 decimal, >=1→0 decimals. Note: the Lots<0.1 branch is unreachable due to MathMax(0.1,Lots) clamp.

custom_logic_notes: SL/TP input values are in absolute price terms (0.0035/0.007) not pips — they are added/subtracted directly from Ask/Bid without _Point multiplication. This assumes a specific symbol (likely EURUSD 5-digit) where 0.0035=35 pips. The buy condition checks Stoch[0]<30 AND Stoch[1]>Stoch[2] which is a rising stochastic exiting oversold. The sell condition checks Stoch[0]>70 AND Stoch[1]<Stoch[2] which is a falling stochastic exiting overbought. MA direction uses 3-bar confirmation (MA[0]<MA[1]<MA[2] for rising). The input Lot=5 is unused — Money_M() calculates dynamic lots instead.
python_conversion_notes: SL/TP are absolute price offsets (not pip-based), must convert to pip-based or keep as price offsets depending on target framework. Money_M() logic is self-contained and portable. No new-bar guard means signals fire every tick while conditions hold — needs throttling in Python (once-per-bar or cooldown). Stochastic uses main line (buffer 0) only. MA uses main line (buffer 0). CopyBuffer reads 3 values [0..2] for both indicators — Python equivalent needs 3-bar lookback for trend confirmation. Position check uses PositionSelect(_Symbol) — single-symbol single-position model.
